title: In the know: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 44

## In the know

**Word Power 44 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Well informed; having more information about something than most people.

### Usage

1. Someone in the know told me he is going to resign.
2. I'll ask the secretary what went on at the meeting. It's her job to be in the know.

### Your turn

Use “in the know” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
